members.name: Bowral
members.bio: Highlands hub town with Corbett Gardens, main-street cafes and a trail past Don Bradman's childhood homes.

members.name: Berrima
members.bio: Georgian sandstone village on the old Hume Highway, with a courthouse, district museum, galleries and cafes.

members.name: Bradman Museum
members.bio: Cricket museum and hall of fame at Bradman Oval, St Jude Street, Bowral.

members.name: Mount Gibraltar
members.bio: Extinct volcano above Mittagong with a rim walk and lookouts over the Southern Highlands.

members.name: Mittagong
members.bio: Highlands town at the foot of Mount Gibraltar, known for its antique and second-hand shops.

members.name: Big Potato
members.bio: Giant potato on the Illawarra Highway at Robertson, repainted in 2025 for the 30th anniversary of Babe.
members.hours: Visible from the road at any time

members.name: Mount Kosciuszko
members.bio: Australia's highest mainland peak at 2228 m, reached by a 13 km return walk from the Thredbo chairlift.
members.hours: Daylight hours; summit walk snowbound June to October
members.photo_file: Kosciuszko NP Mount Kosciuszko seen from Kosciuszko lookout.jpg

members.name: Thredbo
members.bio: Alpine village and ski resort with summer chairlift access to walks and the Kosciuszko summit track.
members.hours: Village open all year; summer lifts November to April
members.photo_file: Kosciuszko NP Thredbo Village seen from the bottom of the bobsled lift.jpg

members.name: Charlotte Pass
members.bio: Alpine resort village below Mount Kosciuszko, a summer walking base reached by oversnow transport in winter.
members.hours: Lookout open all year; no car access June to October

members.name: Blue Lake
members.bio: One of mainland Australia's four glacial lakes, seen from a lookout on the Main Range walk.
members.hours: Summer only; snowbound June to October

members.name: Jindabyne
members.bio: Lakeside town below the snowline on Lake Jindabyne, the main base for the Snowy Mountains.

members.name: Lake Eucumbene
members.bio: Large Snowy Scheme reservoir near Adaminaby, popular for fishing and boating.

members.name: Big Merino
members.bio: Three-storey concrete and steel merino ram called Rambo, 15 m high and built in 1985, in Goulburn.
members.hours: Statue visible from the road at any time

members.name: Bungonia National Park
members.bio: Limestone gorge park with a slot canyon, the Lookdown lookout, caving and canyoning near Marulan.
members.hours: Park always open; office 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM
